serp_title: Ear-Tip Fit and Acoustic Seal Guide
snippet: A stable acoustic seal depends on tip size, insertion angle and the shape of the listener's ear canal.
searchable_text: Ear-Tip Fit Guide Ear-Tip Fit and Acoustic Seal Guide A stable acoustic seal depends on tip size, insertion angle and the shape of the listener's ear canal. Fit procedure Choose the smallest tip that seals without discomfort. Insert the earbud and rotate it into its supported position. Run the device fit check where available. Try the adjacent tip size if bass response or noise cancellation is unstable. Clean and dry tips before refitting. Acoustic effects A poor seal can reduce low-frequency response and change active-noise-control behavior even when wireless and battery functions are normal.

Troubleshooting sequence Check whether the source application paused or stopped. Review Bluetooth reconnection events and host power settings. Confirm that neither earbud was removed or returned to the case. Identify the first earbud that stopped producing audio. Keep the player and device logs with the run sheet. Owner care Keep earbuds and case dry before charging. Wipe contacts with a clean, dry swab. Avoid storing the product fully depleted for long periods.
